title: Rapid Detection of H5 Hemagglutinin by Immunochromatographic Kit Using Monoclonal Antibody
author: Hokkaido University
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.icmcau6

steps.title: Prepare H5 Immunochromatographic (IC) Kit
steps.instruction: Manufacture the New Linjudge Flu A/H5 kit using monoclonal antibodies (MAbs) A64/1 and A32/2.

substeps.instruction: Conjugate a mixture of anti-H5 HA MAbs A64/1 and A32/2 with colloidal gold at a proper ratio.
Immobilize the cocktail of A64/1 and A32/2 onto a nitrocellulose membrane to create the test judgment region.
Immobilize anti-mouse immunoglobulin antibodies onto the nitrocellulose membrane to create the control judgment region.

steps.title: Propagate Influenza Viruses
steps.instruction: Propagate influenza virus strains in embryonated chicken eggs.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate the allantoic cavity of 10-day-old embryonated chicken eggs.
Harvest the infectious allantoic fluid and store at -80 °C until use.

steps.title: Perform Virus Titration (TCID 50)
steps.instruction: Determine the 50% tissue culture infectious dose (TCID 50) using MDCK cells.

substeps.instruction: Maintain MDCK cells in minimum essential medium supplemented with 0.3 mg/mL L-glutamine, 100 U/mL penicillin G, 0.1 mg/mL streptomycin, 8 mg/mL gentamicin, and 10% calf serum.
Prepare ten-fold dilutions of viruses in serum-free minimal essential medium.
Inoculate the dilutions onto confluent monolayers of cells and incubate at 35 °C for 1 h.
Incubate for an additional 72 h at 35 °C and observe for cytopathic effects.
Calculate TCID 50 titers using the method of Read and Muench (1938).

steps.title: Perform Virus Titration (EID 50)
steps.instruction: Measure the 50% egg infectious dose (EID 50) for H5 avian influenza viruses using 10-day chicken embryos.

substeps.instruction: Perform dilution and titer calculation following the same procedure as the TCID 50 method.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Homogenates
steps.instruction: Prepare 10% tissue homogenates from infected birds for use as test samples.

substeps.instruction: Use transport medium consisting of minimal essential medium containing 10,000 U/mL Penicillin G, 10 mg/mL Streptomycin, 0.3 mg/mL Gentamicin, 250 U/mL Nystatin, and 0.5% bovine serum albumin fraction V.

steps.title: Perform IC Kit Detection
steps.instruction: Detect H5 HA antigen in samples using the IC kit.

substeps.instruction: Suspend 10 μL of sample solution in 90 μL of test solution (TAUNS Laboratories, Inc. Shizuoka, Japan).
Apply the 100 μL suspension to the sample port of the kit.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 min.
Interpret results: a single colored line in the control region (C) is negative; concurrent colored lines in both control (C) and test (T) regions are positive.
Record positive intensity on a scale from + to 6+.
Optionally measure optical absorbance using a DiaScan 10-T fluorescent immunochromato reader to standardize visual judgment.
